policy.scope: named marks are isolated by rule label for the duration of one parser execution
policy.storage: backends may store native offsets internally, but public positions, lines, and columns are character-based
policy.names: an unquoted identifier in a mark-name argument is the symbolic mark name rather than a working-variable read
policy.missing: mark_pos, mark_line, and mark_col return undef for an absent mark; mark_exists returns 0
policy.clear: clear_mark deletes only the named mark in the current rule and returns undef
policy.entry: entry writers snapshot the immediate entry-match left and right edges
policy.local: match writers snapshot the current local-match left and right edges
